title: Andre Swish Lyricism shines bright on his recent track "EveryTime"
htmlContent:
Australian-based star Andre Swish is a fully-realized artist and songwriter who has taken the time to learn about his craft and where it will lead him shortly. The talented star is destined for greatness with the release of his recent track titled "EveryTime."

In his single "EveryTime," Andre Swish talks more about depression and how to feel when going through it. The lyrical genius expresses his concern for depressed individuals and tells them they don't have to handle all doom and gloom when going through it.
